title: Campaign ON/OFF blocked behind a held write lock

model.expr: sum by (campaign_id, platform) (count_over_time({service_namespace="soma", deployment_environment="production"} |= "Campaign toggle lock unavailable" | json campaign_id, platform [2m]))

annotations.summary: {{ $labels.platform }} campaign {{ $labels.campaign_id }} could not get its ON/OFF write lock for over ~30s
annotations.description: More than 40 'Campaign toggle lock unavailable' lines in 2 minutes for one campaign: about 30s of continuous polling, so a pause or reopen is waiting on another holder. Before backend #1770 a cancelled scheduled enable kept this lock for its full 300s safety window. A firing alert means a pause or reopen is stuck and the vendor may be ON with nobody free, or OFF while a rep is free. Check the campaign_toggle_locks row (acquired_at, agent_key) and the ingestion/scheduler logs for the campaign around the alert time.
